name: nuImages — Large-Scale 2D Autonomous Driving Image Dataset
description: Large-scale 2D autonomous driving perception dataset released by Motional as part of the nuScenes ecosystem. Contains 93,000 carefully curated high-resolution camera images selected from 800 hours of driving video in Boston and Singapore. Richly annotated with 2D bounding boxes and pixel-level semantic and instance segmentation masks across 25 object classes, specifically selected to represent rare, hazardous, and diverse driving situations (night, rain, heavy traffic, and diverse pedestrian appearances).

provenance.curation_notes: nuImages is the standalone 2D image and instance-mask counterpart to the 3D multimodal nuScenes video sequences. It does not have an independent dataset DOI; the official devkit instructs users to cite the overarching nuScenes paper (Caesar et al., 2020).
